Rene Coig renecoig@uw.edu

Load required packages
```{r,load packages}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(growthcurver)
```
Read in data
```{r,read in raw data}
MDev <- read.csv("TDO 072023/TDO M DevTimeAdd.csv")
FDev <- read.csv("TDO 072023/TDO F DevTimeAdd.csv")
Dev<-rbind(FDev,MDev)
```
Compute means
```{r}
Dev%>%group_by(Color,Time,Sex) %>%
  summarise(
    Sex = Sex,
    EggPicker = EggPicker,
    Treatment = Treatment,
    Color = Color,
    group=group,
    Time=Time,
    NTreat = sum(N, na.rm = TRUE))->Dev_Sum
Dev_Sum<-distinct(Dev_Sum)
Dev_Sum$group<-factor(Dev_Sum$group, levels=c('TDO 2.5mM', 'TDO 5mM', 'TDO 10mM'))
levels(Dev_Sum$group)
Dev_Sum$Time<-factor(Dev_Sum$Time)
TDOHighDev<-Dev_Sum%>%filter(group=="TDO 10mM")
TDOMidDev<-Dev_Sum%>%filter(group=="TDO 5mM")
TDOLowDev<-Dev_Sum%>%filter(group=="TDO 2.5mM")
DMSODev<-Dev_Sum%>%filter(Treatment=="DMSO")

Dev%>%group_by(Color,Time,Sex,EggPicker) %>%
  summarise(
    Sex = Sex,
    EggPicker = EggPicker,
    Treatment = Treatment,
    Color = Color,
    group=group,
    Time=Time,
    NTreat = sum(N, na.rm = TRUE))->Dev_Sum2
Dev_Sum2<-distinct(Dev_Sum2)
Dev_Sum2$group<-factor(Dev_Sum2$group, levels=c('TDO 2.5mM', 'TDO 5mM', 'TDO 10mM'))
levels(Dev_Sum2$group)
Dev_Sum2$Time<-factor(Dev_Sum2$Time)
```


```{r}
Dev_Sum$SexTreat<-paste(Dev_Sum$Treatment,Dev_Sum$Sex)
Dev_Sum2$SexTreat<-paste(Dev_Sum2$Treatment,Dev_Sum2$Sex)

ggplot(Dev_Sum, aes(x = Time, y = NTreat, group = interaction(Treatment,Sex)))+
  geom_line(aes(color=Treatment, linetype=Sex),linewidth=1)+
  scale_color_manual(values=c("purple", "black"))+
  facet_grid(~group)+
  xlab("Time point")+
  ylab("Population")+
  ggtitle("Eclosion Time by TDO Concentration and Sex, w[1118]")

ggplot(Dev_Sum2%>%filter(EggPicker=="LH"), aes(x = Time, y = NTreat, group = interaction(Treatment,Sex)))+
  geom_line(aes(color=Treatment, linetype=Sex),linewidth=1)+
  scale_color_manual(values=c("purple", "black"))+
  facet_grid(~group)+
  xlab("Time point")+
  ylab("Population")+
  ggtitle("Eclosion Time by TDO Concentration and Sex, w[1118]")

ggplot(Dev_Sum2%>%filter(EggPicker=="RC"), aes(x = Time, y = NTreat, group = interaction(Treatment,Sex)))+
  geom_line(aes(color=Treatment, linetype=Sex),linewidth=1)+
  scale_color_manual(values=c("purple", "black"))+
  facet_grid(~group)+
  xlab("Time point")+
  ylab("Population")+
  ggtitle("Eclosion Time by TDO Concentration and Sex, w[1118]")
```
ANOVAS
```{r}
summary(aov(NTreat ~ Sex*Color, data = DMSODev))
summary(aov(NTreat ~ Sex*Treatment, data = TDOLowDev))
summary(aov(NTreat ~ Sex*Treatment, data = TDOMidDev))
summary(aov(NTreat ~ Sex*Treatment, data = TDOHighDev))
```
